gahavibhava：ဂဟဝိဘဝ （ပု）

အိမ်၏စည်းစိမ်၊ အိမ်အသုံးအဆောင်။
DOP: 1 gaha m.n. [ S. gṛha; cf BHS gaha], a house; a home; a storehouse ; Abh 206 (gharaṃ ~aṃ); 919 (ghare ~o); D II 243, 25* (tasmā ’haṃ na ~e rame; Sv 667, 19 : ~e ti gehe); Ja III 396, 4* (na ~e rame, brahmacariyassa kālo, Be, Ee so; Ce, Se gehe); Ap 274,13 (pitu ~e, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se ghare); Paṭis-a 685, 6 (~an ti gehaṃ vuccati); — ifc see dāru-; — °- kāraka , °-kāra, m. , a housebuilder; a mason, a carpenter ; Dhp 153 (sandhāvissaṃ … ~aṃ gavesanto, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be °-kāraṃ; Dhp-a III 128, 6 foll. : imassa attabhāvagehassa kārakaṃ taṇhā-vaḍḍhakiṃ gavesanto, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se attabhāva-saṅkhātassa gehassa) ≠ Th 183 (°-kāraṃ); Dhp 154 (~a diṭṭho si puna gehaṃ na kāhasi) = Th 184; Sadd 548, 10 (vaddhakī ti ~o); — °- kūṭa , n. [gaha + kūṭa 1 ], the roof-peak of a house ; Dhp 154 (sabbā ete phāsukā bhaggā, ~aṃ visaṅkhitaṃ; Dhp-a III 128, 22 foll. : imassa tayā katassa attabhāvagehassa avijjāsaṅkhātaṃ kaṇṇika-maṇḍalaṃ pi mayā viddhaṃsitaṃ); Sadd 636, 3 ; — °- ṭṭha , m. , °-ṭṭhā, f. [ BHS gahastha], one who lives in a house; a householder; a lay-person (very often contrasted with pabbajita ) ; Abh 446; Vin III 89, 35 (pūjito apacito ~ānaṃ c’ eva pabbajitānaṃ ca); M II 205, 17 (~o hi … mahaṭṭho mahākicco mahādhikaraṇo mahā-samārambho, na satataṃ samitaṃ saccavādī hoti); S I 234, 28* (ye ~ā puññakarā sīlavanto upāsakā dhammena dāraṃ posenti te namassāmi); Dhp 404 (asaṃsaṭṭhaṃ ~ehi anāgārehi cūbhayaṃ); It 112, 6* (~ā gharamesino); Sn 487 (yo yācayogo dānapatī ~o puññatthiko yajati puññapekho); Ja VI 286, 18* (vasamānassa ~assa sakaṃ gharaṃ); Ap 573, 28 (ekākinī ~ā ’haṃ); Kv 42, 21 ; Sp 1143, 12 (yo nibaddhaṃ cetiyapaṭijaggako hoti pabbajito vā ~o vā); It-a II 55, 32 (~ā hi anibaddhasīlā honti, yaṃ yaṃ sakkonti taṃ tad eva rakkhanti); Th-a II 212, 24 (~-sīlaṃ nāma pañcasikkhāpadasīlaṃ yaṃ ~ena rakkhituṃ sakkā); Bv-a 92, 6 (pabbajitā yeva hi bodhisattā sambodhiṃ adhigacchanti na ~ā); — sagahaṭṭha, mfn. , with householders; including laypeople ; Vin I 115, 24 (Devadatto sagahaṭṭhāya parisāya pātimokkhaṃ uddisati); — °- ṭṭhaka , mfn. , belonging to or suitable for one who lives in a house ; A II 35, 25 (yāni kho pana tāni ~āni kiṃkaraṇīyāni tattha dakkho hoti analaso); III 296, 8 (yathā no soḷasavassāni ~aṃ brahma-cariyaṃ samāciṇṇaṃ); — °- pata , °- patānī , °- pati , °- patika , see svv ; — °- ppavesamaṅgala , n. , the ceremony of entering a new house ; Nidd-a I 416, 2 (~aṃ kātabbaṃ, Ce, Ee so; Be geha-; Se gehappavesana-); — °- vibhava , m. , domestic property or wealth ; Thī 327 (phītaṃ c’ imaṃ ~aṃ pahāya, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se geha-vigataṃ, prob. wr ; Thī-a 220, 23 : ~aṃ gehūpakaraṇaṃ); — agaha, see sv agiha ; — see also giha, geha 1 .
